title: The UEM Agent must record the reference identifier of the UEM Server during the enrollment process.
check_content:
Verify the UEM Agent records the reference identifier of the UEM Server during the enrollment process.

If the UEM Agent does not record the reference identifier of the UEM Server during the enrollment process, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the UEM Agent to record the reference identifier of the UEM Server during the enrollment process.
VulnDiscussion:
Audit logs enable monitoring of security-relevant events and subsequent forensics when breaches occur. For audit logs to be useful, administrators must have the ability to view them.

Satisfies: FIA_ENR_EXT.2.1
